title: Create an in-memory Key-Value store with TTL and REST API
description:
In the workspace, create a Node.js ESM package that implements an in-memory Key-Value store. Features: set(key, value, ttlMs), get(key) -> value or null, del(key). It should support a simple Express or HTTP server with endpoints: POST /set, GET /get?key=..., DELETE /del?key=...
Requirements:
- Language: JavaScript (Node ESM).
- Use `node --test`.
- Write tests for TTL expiry (use small timeouts or mocked timers).
- Ensure the server can be started and stopped cleanly for tests.
- Run tests and ensure they pass.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has type=module and a test script
KV store supports TTL expiry correctly
HTTP endpoints exist for get, set, del
